top_signals.title: GTA VI Takes Over Thanksgiving Week
top_signals.summary: On Bloomberg This Weekend, Bloomberg reporter Josyana Joshua tells host Lisa Mateo how the long-awaited release of Grand Theft Auto VI is becoming a cultural and workplace phenomenon, with gamers taking time off and preparing to play through Thanksgiving week. Joshua explains how the game’s 13-year buildup is driving demand for consoles and gaming gear while potentially competing with family gatherings, football and other holiday entertainment. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Social Security benefits are rising in 2027, but other changes could affect what you keep
top_signals.summary: A 3.6% Social Security cost-of-living adjustment for 2027 will increase benefits across the board. But Medicare and tax changes will also affect retirees.
